{{Quote|Governor Dannal and Senator Chelo have been ordered to report to the Emperor on Coruscant to explain their failure to eradicate the disease of rebellion while it was yet in its embryonic stage.|[[Imperial HoloVision]] report|<ref name="GNN3" />}}
[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] '''Dannal''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] official in charge of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gerrard V]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Following an [[Uprising on Gerrard V|uprising]] by local [[Gerrard V Rebels|rebels]] that required the intervention of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Governor Dannal and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Chelo]] were ordered to report to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to explain their failure to prevent rebellion on the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
Dannal was first mentioned in the [[1994]] [[Galaxywide NewsNets]] section of [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 3]]. The [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] features a separate [[Liberation of Gerrard V|separate uprising]]. No source has linked Dannal to the [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Gerrard V)|governor]] of the other uprising.
